market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH at ~$2,277 on Apr 28, 2026. Hitting $1,500 requires a ~34% drop. ETH has high volatility and already trades far below its 2024 highs. With 8 months remaining and bearish macro pressure, $1,500 is plausible but requires significant further decline. ETH has been weaker than BTC year-to-date.
